summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the issuance by The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation of $750M each of 4.540% and 5.085% Fixed/Floating Rate Callable Senior Medium-Term Notes due 2032 and 2037, respectively, under an existing shelf registration (Form S-3). This is an ordinary debt offering with no special-situation characteristics such as acquisitions, restructuring, or activism. The issuer acted as the borrower; no premium, consideration, or deal terms are present beyond coupon rates and maturities. The event is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
